meta.notes: The comfyui-krea2edit nodes' graph (lbouaraba/comfyui-krea2edit v2, Apache-2.0; its workflows/krea2_identity_edit.json read 2026-10-27), single-image mode: the edit LoRA on the model, Krea2EditModelPatch with the picture as the clean in-context source (frame 1, 'aligned (trained)', fit mode, ref_boost 4 as the General Edit V2 card recommends for Turbo), Krea2EditGroundedEncode with the picture in the encoder's view at 768 px for the instruction and empty for the negative (CFG 1 does not use it), an empty latent at the picture's size, KSampler euler/simple 8 steps CFG 1. The two custom nodes are not in ComfyUI core: on the ComfyUI route the app names them as missing. ShotoPhopEX's native worker serves this template itself (genai-native gn-diffusion krea2-turbo/edit) when the LoRA is in its loras folder.
